summary: Inuvo filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement suspending its at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright effective June 30, 2026. The ATM had previously sold 165,641 shares for ~$1.18M gross proceeds, with up to $15M still authorized. No shares will be sold under the ATM until a new prospectus supplement is filed; the agreement remains in effect. The filing is a routine suspension of a continuous equity offering program, not a special situation. No deal terms, prices, or board recommendations are involved.
